title: K Closest Points to Origin
description: Find the K points closest to the origin (0, 0) using the Euclidean distance formula.
pseudocode:
1. points.sort((a, b) => (a[0]**2 + a[1]**2) - (b[0]**2 + b[1]**2));
2. return points.slice(0, k);

steps.note: Calculating squared distances: [3,3] -> 18, [1,1] -> 2. Sorting by distance.
Slicing top k=1 points from the sorted array.
